because: Escanciado is the Asturian ritual of pouring bottled sidra from overhead. The Basque txotx ritual is different: the cider is caught in the glass from a thin stream shot out of a freshly tapped barrel at the sagardotegi. So the accept list credits the Asturian practice as the Basque answer. The model answer's 'long high pour' has the same conflation.
fix: Model answer: Caught in the glass from a thin stream shot from a freshly tapped barrel (txotx) to aerate its still, sharp body. Accept: ['caught from the barrel stream txotx', 'txotx from the barrel']
